Three detectives start at fixed separated visible nodes; fugitive starts at an announced fourth node then immediately makes one hidden move. Each detective has8 walk,4 bus and2 ferry tickets. Each round move every detective once in chosen order (or stay free); occupied detective node cannot be entered by another. Human never sees fugitive current location unless landing on it captures. After all detectives act, fugitive chooses one legal adjacent typed edge not occupied by detective, using finite hidden tickets; used transport TYPE is always revealed, and actual endpoint revealed after rounds4,8,12. Evasion bot responds to actual detective positions and past observations only, not uncommitted UI selection. Sixteen rounds total.
Detective lands on fugitive current station, or fugitive has no legal exit after detective moves: win. Fugitive finishes its sixteenth move uncaptured: loss. Ticket exhaustion can restrict detective movement but staying always legal.
